index.seoTitle: Lapland nature news: research from the fells
index.description: Research news about the nature of Finnish Lapland: the fells, their wildlife, plants and seasons. Every story names and links its sources.
index.lead: What new research says about the nature of Finnish Lapland, written from the original papers and press releases, with every source named and linked.
index.aboutText: We open every source before writing and report only what it says. Where a press release and the research paper differ, we say which one a number comes from, and we link both.
index.heroAlt: The Teno river and autumn-coloured slopes near Kuoppilasjoki in Utsjoki
